content: SIMD 2-bit encoding + bit-parallel revcomp: replace O(k) per-window encode_kmer_bytes_u128 + O(k) reverse_complement_u128 (current rustkmer hot path) with rolling 2-bit shift-in + word-level revcomp (byte-swap+complement), u64 for k<=32. simd-minimizers (rust-seq, SEA 2025, AVX2/NEON, 32-bit ntHash + two-stack sliding min, ~4s/human-genome single-thread, canonical ~6s) provides rolling hash+minimizers together. Verify MSRV<=1.80 + aarch64 NEON + PyO3 before adopting.
